pattern: IM-T07 late stage: the guarantee return visit is recorded as 'no charge' by the provider, then the same provider invoices GBP 90.00 for the return call-out
notes: Base 042-repair-failed-recurs (events 001-032 unchanged) plus appended events 033-037 (Mon 4 March 2024: reopened as a return visit; guarantee request to Lantern at no further charge, with the 28/02 invoice on hold; landlord Mercer and tenant informed; hold Waiting for Provider) and 038 (Tue 5 March: return booked Wed 6 March 10am-12pm). 039 (Wed 6 March 12:40): Lantern's work result says the crimp connector on the element terminal had worked loose, re-terminated, tested on 60°C and 90°C, 'No charge, covered under our guarantee'. 040 (Thu 7 March 08:15): invoice email from Lantern for GBP 90.00 'Return visit call-out, NBL-042, 06/03/2024', in the same summarised style as the source's event 024. Total events 40, cut after 040. Expected: do not pay or pass the £90 to the landlord; hold it and ask Lantern to withdraw or credit it, quoting their own no-charge work result and the agreed guarantee basis; ask the tenant to confirm the machine is heating before the job is closed and before the original £75.11 hold is lifted; keep the landlord informed that no extra cost is due. No escalation: a billing query to the contractor is routine.
